VEHICLE PURCHASE AGREEMENT

This Vehicle Purchase Agreement is made as of April 4, 2026 between Hollis Motors, Inc. ("Dealer") and Robin Carraway ("Buyer").

1. Sale. Dealer sells Buyer the blue pickup truck that Buyer test-drove on April 3, 2026.

2. Payment. Buyer will pay Dealer when Buyer picks up the truck.

3. Pickup. Buyer will pick up the truck from Dealer's lot within one week. Dealer will wash the truck and fill the fuel tank before pickup.

HOLLIS MOTORS, INC.
